source.title: 阿瓦隆大莫巧使离间计，派梅互打天崩局

interval.rationale: Cold open ends at 49.27 s; extraction retains 49.3..1890 for audit. Actual public play starts at 60.5 s and stops just after mission 4 result at 1843.55 s. The last 46 s are endgame reactions and post-game role reveal (explicit 赛后 from 1857.65 s), contrary to the earlier unreviewed note.

basis.player_count: board vote strips run 1-10; the roster strip lists seats 1-10
basis.mission_team_sizes: board round headers: 第2轮任务·需要4名队员, 第3轮任务·需要4名队员, 第4轮任务·需要5名队员. Round 1's size is not on any board frame sampled but the client announces it in a caption at 250 s: 本轮任务需要三位玩家. Round 5 was never reached on screen, so its size is NOT stated anywhere and is not listed.
basis.proposal_limit: board rows read 第1/3次组队, 第2/3次组队
basis.final_proposal_forced: observed: a third row reading 必做轮组队 with no tally (2号队长→2·4·5·8 必做轮组队 必做轮)
basis.fails_required: Mission 4 board explicitly says 保护轮 and shows two fails; exact threshold has not yet been established from an in-game rules explanation. Omitted from input.
basis.lady_of_the_lake: observed on the board: 湖中仙女 rows appear after round 2's result and after round 3's result. Only those two uses are listed because only those two were seen; the standard third use after round 4 is NOT assumed. The two seat numbers in each row are circular avatar badges that OCR drops, so who held it and who was checked are not recoverable from the board.
basis.role_composition: Source roster at 1880.017 s, visually verified for all 10 seats and checked against OCR; only counts are public input rules.
